title: How Trump’s Conviction Could Reshape the Election

sentences.en: 33 presidents.

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: How the criminal conviction of Donald Trump will shape the remaining months of the presidential race and potentially its outcome.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的刑事定罪将如何影响总统竞选剩下的几个月，并可能影响其最终结果。

sentences.en: My colleagues, Nate Cohn, Maggie Haberman, and Reid Epstein, explain.
sentences.zh: 我的同事内特·科恩、玛吉·哈伯曼和里德·爱泼斯坦将对此进行解读。

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月3日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hello, Nate.
sentences.zh: 你好，内特。

sentences.en: Hello, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So it's been three days since Donald Trump was convicted of 34 felony charges.
sentences.zh: 距离唐纳德·特朗普被判34项重罪指控已经过去三天了。

sentences.en: And now that the dust is starting to settle, it feels like we have to turn to the question of its impact on the election.
sentences.zh: 现在尘埃开始落定，感觉我们必须转向探讨它对选举的影响这一问题。

sentences.en: And you are our resident polling expert at The Times.
sentences.zh: 你是我们《时报》的常驻民调专家。

sentences.en: And so we want you to frame that question with as much data as we possibly can.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望你能尽可能多地用数据来构建这个问题。

sentences.en: There's always been a sense that for a lot of voters, a Trump conviction wouldn't change a thing.
sentences.zh: 一直有一种感觉，对于很多选民来说，特朗普被定罪不会改变任何事情。

sentences.en: So whose vote, according to all the polls you conduct and study, might this conviction actually influence?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据你们进行和研究的所有民调，这次定罪实际上可能会影响谁的投票呢？

sentences.en: What's that universe?
sentences.zh: 那部分群体是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, we haven't yet conducted any polls since the conviction.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还没有在定罪后进行任何民调。

sentences.en: So all of this is strictly theoretical.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切纯粹是理论上的。

sentences.en: But before the conviction, even before the trial, we were asking voters what they would do, how they would vote if Donald Trump was convicted of a serious crime.
sentences.zh: 但在定罪前，甚至在审判前，我们就问过选民，如果唐纳德·特朗普被判犯有重罪，他们会怎么做，会如何投票。

sentences.en: And when we gave voters that hypothetical, a small but still meaningful group of Donald Trump supporters told us that they would then vote for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 当我们给选民提出那个假设时，一小部分但仍然意义重大的唐纳德·特朗普支持者告诉我们，他们届时会转而投票给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How small but meaningful?
sentences.zh: 有多小但意义重大？

sentences.en: So in our Times-Siena battleground polls in October,
sentences.zh: 在去年十月我们的《时报》与锡耶纳学院的摇摆州民调中，

sentences.en: 7% of Donald Trump supporters said they would vote for Joe Biden if Donald Trump was convicted of a felony.
sentences.zh: 7%的唐纳德·特朗普支持者表示，如果唐纳德·特朗普被判重罪，他们会投票给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Now, it's just a hypothetical.
sentences.zh: 现在，这只是一个假设。

sentences.en: But 7% is real.
sentences.zh: 但7%是真实的。

sentences.en: 7% isn't just real.
sentences.zh: 7%不仅仅是真实的。

sentences.en: In our era of close elections, it's easily decisive.
sentences.zh: 在我们这个选举胶着的时代，这很容易成为决定性因素。

sentences.en: The race might not even be close.
sentences.zh: 选情甚至可能不再胶着。

sentences.en: But it's important to emphasize, and I can't emphasize this enough, that asking voters a hypothetical is not a realistic simulation of what will actually happen now.
sentences.zh: 但必须强调的是，我怎么强调都不为过，向选民询问一个假设情况，并不是对现在实际会发生什么情况的现实模拟。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They didn't even know what trial it was about.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不知道审判是关于什么的。

sentences.en: We just put in their face, he's guilty, now what?
sentences.zh: 我们只是直接摆在他们面前：他有罪，现在怎么办？

sentences.en: That's not the way it's going to work in the real world.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，事情不会那样运作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it shows that a meaningful sliver of Trump supporters are uncomfortable with the idea of voting for Trump once he's been convicted of a felony.
sentences.zh: 但这表明，一小部分重要的特朗普支持者对特朗普一旦被判重罪还要投票给他感到不安。

sentences.en: And moreover, they were even willing to say they support or would support Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们甚至愿意说他们支持或会支持乔·拜登。

sentences.en: They said to the pollster Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 他们对民调人员说了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: That's a real line for a Trump voter to cross.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普选民来说是一条真正的底线。

sentences.en: I'm hearing you say that this could, could, could, could conditional be a game changer.
sentences.zh: 我听出你的意思是，这可能、可能、可能、可能——有条件地——成为一个改变游戏规则的因素。

sentences.en: Look, I'm not a strategist, but the fact that there's this sliver of voters who are repelled by the idea of Donald Trump as a convict means that now that he is a convicted felon,
sentences.zh: 听着，我不是战略家，但确实有这样一小部分选民对唐纳德·特朗普作为罪犯的想法感到反感，这意味着既然他现在是一名被定罪的重罪犯，

sentences.en: how the Biden campaign and the Trump campaign handle this issue, how they talk about this conviction, how they try and exploit it,
sentences.zh: 拜登竞选团队和特朗普竞选团队如何处理这个问题，他们如何谈论这次定罪，他们如何试图利用它，

sentences.en: could easily be decisive in a close election this November.
sentences.zh: 在今年十一月胶着的选举中，很容易成为决定性因素。

sentences.en: You ready to go, Maggie?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗，玛吉？

sentences.en: I'm ready to go.
sentences.zh: 我准备好了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, from what Nate Cohn just told us, the election could theoretically hinge on how both candidates decide
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉，根据内特·科恩刚才告诉我们的，理论上选举可能取决于两位候选人决定

sentences.en: to talk about and campaign around this criminal conviction of Trump.
sentences.zh: 如何谈论和围绕特朗普的这次刑事定罪进行竞选。

sentences.en: So, as a longtime student and observer of Donald Trump, take us into his emerging strategy for how to approach and, if possible, capitalize on this conviction.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为唐纳德·特朗普的长期研究者和观察者，带我们了解一下他正在形成的应对策略，以及如果可能的话，他如何利用这次定罪。

sentences.en: So, let's just start with how he's feeling about this, which is quite angry.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们先从他的感受开始，他非常愤怒。

sentences.en: We know that this verdict, according to several people who have spoken to him, has infuriated him.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，据几位与他交谈过的人说，这一判决让他大发雷霆。

sentences.en: This is clearly not the outcome he wanted.
sentences.zh: 这显然不是他想要的结果。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to be convicted of a crime.
sentences.zh: 没有人想被判有罪。

sentences.en: And if you think about it, Trump has lived in a legal gray area for decades, but prior to the last 16 months or so, he had never been charged with a crime.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，特朗普几十年来一直生活在法律的灰色地带，但在过去16个月左右之前，他从未被指控犯有罪行。

sentences.en: And even though privately he had told people from the outset he expected he would get convicted, he is a big believer in his own luck,
sentences.zh: 尽管他在私下里从一开始就告诉人们他预计自己会被定罪，但他非常相信自己的运气，

sentences.en: and he had really hoped that his winning streak would continue.
sentences.zh: 他真的希望自己的连胜纪录能继续下去。

sentences.en: And it did not.
sentences.zh: 但并没有。

sentences.en: It did not.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: And so this is really hard for him to stomach and to process, frankly.
sentences.zh: 所以坦率地说，这对他来说真的很难接受和消化。

sentences.en: But even before the verdict, it was clear what he was going to do and how he was going to try to spin a guilty verdict.
sentences.zh: 但即使在判决之前，很明显他会怎么做，以及他将如何试图扭曲有罪判决。

sentences.en: So, from the moment he walked out of the courtroom and into the courthouse hallway, where he talked to reporters there.
sentences.zh: 所以，从他走出法庭进入法院走廊的那一刻起，他在那里接受了记者的采访。

sentences.en: This was a disgrace.
sentences.zh: 这是一种耻辱。

sentences.en: This was a rigged trial by a conflicted judge who was corrupt.
sentences.zh: 这是一场由一位有利益冲突且腐败的法官操纵的审判。

sentences.en: We saw what has become his standard playbook emerge from his genuine fury here.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了他那套标准的剧本从他真实的愤怒中浮现出来。

sentences.en: Our whole country is being rigged right now.
sentences.zh: 我们整个国家现在正被操纵。

sentences.en: This was done by the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 这是拜登政府干的。

sentences.en: And that was to characterize this outcome as the inevitable culmination of a years-long partisan campaign to weaponize the legal system against him.
sentences.zh: 其目的就是将这一结果描述为多年来党派运动的必然结果，目的是将法律体系武器化来对付他。

sentences.en: And we'll keep fighting.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续战斗。

sentences.en: We'll fight till the end and we'll win because our country's gone to hell.
sentences.zh: 我们将战斗到底，我们会赢，因为我们的国家已经堕落了。

sentences.en: And his message is fight against this corrupt system.
sentences.zh: 他的信息是：反抗这个腐败的体系。

sentences.en: And by fight against it, his message to voters is, elect me again.
sentences.zh: 而通过反抗它，他给选民的信息是：再次选举我。

sentences.en: And this message takes lots of forMs.
sentences.zh: 这个信息有很多种形式。

sentences.en: The first is a series of fundraising pitches that are coming fast and furiously.
sentences.zh: 首先是一系列接踵而至、来势汹汹的筹款宣传。

sentences.en: I just want to read you a few of them, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我只想给你读几条。

sentences.en: I am a political prisoner.
sentences.zh: 我是政治犯。

sentences.en: Never surrender.
sentences.zh: 永不投降。

sentences.en: I was convicted in a rigged political witch hunt trial.
sentences.zh: 我在一场被操纵的政治猎巫审判中被定罪。

sentences.en: I did nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 我没做错任何事。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: And after these fundraising pitches, it accelerated after the verdict.
sentences.zh: 在这些筹款宣传之后，判决后节奏加快了。

sentences.en: As far as the trial itself, it was very unfair.
sentences.zh: 至于审判本身，非常不公平。

sentences.en: He held this, not really a press conference, but gave a statement.
sentences.zh: 他举行了这次——与其说是新闻发布会，不如说是发表了一份声明。

sentences.en: You saw what happened to some of the witnesses that were on our side.
sentences.zh: 你们看到了我们这边的一些证人发生了什么。

sentences.en: They were literally crucified by this man who looks like an angel, but he's really a devil.
sentences.zh: 他们被这个看起来像天使，但实际上是魔鬼的人彻底钉在了十字架上。

sentences.en: He looks so nice and soft.
sentences.zh: 他看起来那么和善、温和。

sentences.en: A long statement on Friday morning at Trump Tower, where he tried to essentially relitigate the case and cast it in his own way.
sentences.zh: 周五早上在特朗普大厦发表了一份长篇声明，他试图从本质上重新审理此案，并以他自己的方式进行解读。

sentences.en: Legal expense was marked down as legal expense.
sentences.zh: 法律费用被记为法律费用。

sentences.en: Think of it.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: This is my, this is the crime that I committed that I'm supposed to go to jail for 187 years for.
sentences.zh: 这就是我犯下的罪行，我本应为此入狱187年。

sentences.en: And say things that were not true, such as that he faces, you know, 187 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 并且说了一些不真实的话，比如他面临，你知道，187年的监禁。

sentences.en: But this is far beyond me.
sentences.zh: 但这远不止于我。

sentences.en: This is bigger than Trump.
sentences.zh: 这比特朗普更重要。

sentences.en: This is bigger than me.
sentences.zh: 这比我更重要。

sentences.en: This is bigger than my presidency.
sentences.zh: 这比我的总统任期更重要。

sentences.en: And I can fix this system that's corrupt.
sentences.zh: 我可以修复这个腐败的体系。

sentences.en: And you can trust me to take care of it.
sentences.zh: 你可以相信我能处理好它。

sentences.en: November 5th.
Remember, November 5th is the most important day in the history of our country.
sentences.zh: 记住，11月5日是我们国家历史上最重要的一天。

sentences.en: So Trump's plan is quite clearly not in any way so far to avoid talking about what for many people would be a legal stain on your record, but to talk about it a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普的计划很明显，到目前为止，绝不是要避免谈论这对许多人来说是法律污点的事情，而是要大谈特谈。

sentences.en: I mean, he's holding a news conference explicitly to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他专门召开新闻发布会来谈论这件事。

sentences.en: He's sending out all these fundraising messages, referring to it, and he's going to lean into it in those communications to basically say,
sentences.zh: 他发出了所有这些筹款信息，提到了这件事，并且他将在这些交流中倾向于这一点，基本上是说，

sentences.en: that thing I always warned you was happening to me and could happen to me, that the other side would use the legal system against me.
sentences.zh: 我一直警告你们会发生在我身上、也可能发生在我身上的事情，即对方会利用法律体系来对付我。

sentences.en: It's finally happened, and the only way that we can overcome this is if you make me president, and I become the guy sitting atop the entire legal system,
sentences.zh: 它终于发生了，我们克服这一点的唯一方法就是你们让我成为总统，我成为坐在整个法律体系之上的人，

sentences.en: and I can fix it from the inside.
sentences.zh: 我可以从内部修复它。

sentences.en: That's basically the message.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他的信息。

sentences.en: Yes, and that has consistently been his message, Michael.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，这一直是他一贯的信息。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We saw Trump run previously on the idea of, quote, I alone can fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们看到特朗普之前竞选时提出的理念是，引用他的话，“只有我能修复它”。

sentences.en: And that really is what he's saying here.
sentences.zh: 这确实就是他在这里所说的。

sentences.en: He is saying that the only credible law enforcement is me, that all of these efforts to investigate me are tainted, they're political, they're politicized,
sentences.zh: 他是在说，唯一可信的执法者就是我，所有这些调查我的努力都是被玷污的，它们是政治性的，是被政治化的，

sentences.en: and you can fix this by electing me.
sentences.zh: 而你可以通过选举我来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: So how should we be thinking about whether this familiar framework, kind of on steroids, now that Trump has actually been convicted, is working?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们应该如何看待这种熟悉的框架——现在特朗普真的被定罪了，这就像是打了兴奋剂——是否有效呢？

sentences.en: I know it's early, it's basically 72 hours since his conviction, but because he's been so present in presenting this version of events,
sentences.zh: 我知道现在还早，距离他被定罪基本上才72小时，但因为他在呈现这个版本的事件时表现得如此积极，

sentences.en: I wonder how we gauge if it's any kind of a success.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我们如何衡量这是否算是一种成功。

sentences.en: We do have one pretty powerful barometer, which is his fundraising.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有一个相当强大的晴雨表，那就是他的筹款。

sentences.en: He raised an astonishing amount of money in a very short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 他在极短的时间内筹集了惊人的资金。

sentences.en: Shortly after the conviction was announced, the websites where he's asking people to donate crashed from so much traffic.
sentences.zh: 在定罪宣布后不久，他要求人们捐款的网站因为流量太大而崩溃了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And yet, he still managed to raise more than $50 million in less than 36 hours.
sentences.zh: 然而，他仍然在不到36小时内筹集了超过5000万美元。

sentences.en: I mean, that is a little bit hard to wrap your head around.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这有点让人难以理解。

sentences.en: That's well, my math isn't that great, but it's well more than a million dollars an hour.
sentences.zh: 那是——好吧，我的数学不太好，但那远不止每小时一百万美元。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And look, we can't corroborate those numbers until we see the FEC reports.
sentences.zh: 而且听着，在我们看到联邦选举委员会的报告之前，我们无法证实这些数字。

sentences.en: I think it's important to note that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点很重要。

sentences.en: But by all accounts, they've raised a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 但据各方说法，他们筹集了大量的资金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we've talked to our colleagues about Trump's fundraising disadvantage vis-a-vis Joe Biden, which is pretty meaningful.
sentences.zh: 我们和同事谈过特朗普相对于乔·拜登的筹款劣势，这是相当显著的。

sentences.en: It sounds like, of all things, a conviction, a criminal conviction has done more to catch him up to Biden than almost anything else in this campaign.
sentences.zh: 听起来，在所有事情中，定罪，刑事定罪在追赶拜登方面所起的作用比这次竞选中的几乎任何其他事情都大。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: There is a very real possibility that he will, if not erase the gap, significantly close the gap that Biden has over him with fundraising in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 确实存在一种非常现实的可能性，即在未来几周内，他即使不能消除差距，也会显著缩小拜登在筹款方面对他的领先优势。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But I have to say that so far, what you're describing is feeling like a direct appeal to the base, the faithful,
sentences.zh: 但我不得不说，到目前为止，你所描述的感觉像是对基本盘、忠实支持者的直接呼吁，

sentences.en: to those who are primed to love Trump and to see the world as he does, a legal system rigged against him.
sentences.zh: 对那些准备好爱特朗普并像他一样看待世界的人，即一个操纵法律体系来对付他的世界。

sentences.en: It feels less like a strategy for reaching out to the, you know, 7 percent or so of voters who, as Nate told us earlier,
sentences.zh: 这感觉不太像是一种接触那7%左右选民的策略，正如内特之前告诉我们的，

sentences.en: have told pollsters that a conviction might send them from Trump to Biden.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉民调人员，定罪可能会让他们从特朗普转向拜登。

sentences.en: So how should we think about that?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该如何看待这一点？

sentences.en: It's a really good question, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这确实是个好问题。

sentences.en: I think that his advisors would rather that he doesn't spend so much time relitigating the trial details, right?
sentences.zh: 我想他的顾问们肯定宁愿他不要花那么多时间去纠缠审判细节，对吧？

sentences.en: They let Stormy Daniels testify, they let this happen, they let that happen.
sentences.zh: 他们让斯托米·丹尼尔斯作证，他们让这事发生，让那事发生。

sentences.en: His strategists are okay with him putting forward a message about how I'm here fighting for a system that is being perverted in his telling.
sentences.zh: 他的战略家们并不介意他传达这样的信息：我在这里是为了捍卫一个在他口中正被扭曲的体制。

sentences.en: And his advisors think there are enough people, even in the middle,
sentences.zh: 而且他的顾问们认为，即便是在中间派选民中，也有足够多的人，

sentences.en: who are troubled by the relative frivolous case here compared to the much weightier ones of January 6th and the classified documents case,
sentences.zh: 对这起相对琐碎的案件感到困扰，尤其是与1月6日事件和机密文件案这些更重大的案件相比，

sentences.en: that they think that that could have some appeal.
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为这可能会产生一些吸引力。

sentences.en: But the problem is they can't control how Trump is going to talk about this.
sentences.zh: 但问题在于，他们无法控制特朗普会如何谈论这件事。

sentences.en: They can try.
sentences.zh: 他们可以尝试。

sentences.en: And so the question becomes, can he deliver a focused enough message that could appeal to people who worry about how this case came about, was it a contortion of the law,
sentences.zh: 所以问题变成了，他能否传达出足够聚焦的信息，从而吸引那些担心此案起因、担心这是否是对法律的歪曲的人，

sentences.en: and who might be open to that message in the fall.
sentences.zh: 以及那些在秋季大选时可能接受这一信息的人。

sentences.en: And meantime, from what I'm seeing, Maggie,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，据我所见，玛吉，

sentences.en: it seems like everyone in the Republican Party seems to be taking their cues from Trump and really going all in on this strategy of trying to use this conviction to win over voters.
sentences.zh: 共和党内的每个人似乎都在看特朗普的眼色行事，并真的全力投入到这种试图利用定罪来争取选民的策略中。

sentences.en: Well, they don't even need much of a cue to take, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，他们甚至不需要什么眼色。

sentences.en: They already know what Trump wants them to say.
sentences.zh: 他们早就知道特朗普想让他们说什么了。

sentences.en: But yes, I mean, everybody is pushing it front and center.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我的意思是，每个人都在把它推向风口浪尖。

sentences.en: The court system is weaponized.
sentences.zh: 司法系统被武器化了。

sentences.en: It is used to go after political opponents and people who work for them.
sentences.zh: 它被用来对付政治对手及其工作人员。

sentences.en: I woke up heartbroken for our country because the precedent set is that if you don't like somebody's politics,
sentences.zh: 我醒来时为我们的国家感到心碎，因为开创的先例是：如果你不喜欢某人的政治立场，

sentences.en: you should use the American system of law and order to try and destroy them.
sentences.zh: 你就应该利用美国的法律和秩序体系去试图摧毁他们。

sentences.en: You're seeing Marco Rubio and J.D.
sentences.zh: 你看看马可·卢比奥和J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, who are two top vice presidential picks, talking about the verdict and talking about it in very derisive terms and what it might mean for the future.
sentences.zh: 万斯，这两位顶尖的副总统人选，都在谈论这一判决，而且用词非常尖刻，还谈到了它对未来的意义。

sentences.en: The entire argument of this case is that Donald Trump should go to prison because an employee of his filled out paperwork the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 这起案件的全部论点就是，唐纳德·特朗普应该入狱，因为他的一名员工填错了文书工作。

sentences.en: This is disgraceful.
sentences.zh: 这太可耻了。

sentences.en: And you're seeing governors talk about it.
sentences.zh: 你看到州长们在谈论它。

sentences.en: You're seeing local lawmakers talking about it.
sentences.zh: 你看到地方议员们在谈论它。

sentences.en: You're seeing the House speaker talk about it.
sentences.zh: 你看到众议院议长在谈论它。

sentences.en: You are seeing everybody talk about it.
sentences.zh: 你看到所有人都在谈论它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He is the leader of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 他是共和党的领袖。

sentences.en: And instead of cleaving them away from him, it's moving them closer.
sentences.zh: 这不仅没有让他们远离他，反而让他们靠得更近了。

sentences.en: And he has just tightened his grip.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚进一步巩固了自己的控制力。

sentences.en: Whether that is something durable in a general election where most voters are going to vote about how candidates impact their own lives and how policies impact their own lives,
sentences.zh: 这在总统大选中是否持久，毕竟大多数选民投票时会考虑候选人如何影响他们的生活以及政策如何影响他们的生活，

sentences.en: we just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们还不得而知。

sentences.en: But they are very much putting this front and center for the time being.
sentences.zh: 但目前他们确实把这件事放在了首要位置。

sentences.en: I want to talk about that for just a minute because we've long understood that Republican officials at very high levels are willing to mimic whatever Trump is saying after the Access Hollywood video,
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈这一点，因为我们早就明白，共和党的高层官员愿意模仿特朗普所说的任何话，比如2016年《走进好莱坞》录音带事件后，

sentences.en: for example, in 2016, during the impeachments.
sentences.zh: 以及在弹劾期间。

sentences.en: But this feels different.
sentences.zh: 但这感觉不同。

sentences.en: We're now seeing members of the United States Senate, for example, Vance and Rubio, embracing a message of outright lawlessness.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到美国参议院的成员，比如万斯和卢比奥，正在拥护一种彻底的无法无天的信息。

sentences.en: You know, this is supposedly the party of law and order.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这本应是崇尚法律和秩序的政党。

sentences.en: So it's surprising not just to see them embracing a convicted felon in Donald Trump, but embracing him at the very moment when he is saying to the world, this is stupid,
sentences.zh: 所以，不仅看到他们拥护唐纳德·特朗普这位被定罪的重罪犯令人惊讶，而且是在他向全世界宣称这很愚蠢、

sentences.en: this is rigged, this doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 这是操纵的、这毫无意义的时候拥护他，这更令人惊讶。

sentences.en: I just don't think we've ever really seen that before in American politics.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我们在美国政治中从未真正见过这种情况。

sentences.en: Michael, I'm going to go ahead and disagree a bit with your premise.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我要稍微反驳一下你的前提。

sentences.en: I don't think there's anything surprising about this because Donald Trump has so thoroughly remade the Republican Party where what he wants it to be is what everyone does.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这有什么令人惊讶的，因为唐纳德·特朗普已经彻底重塑了共和党，他想要它成为什么样，大家就都照做。

sentences.en: And we have seen this over the course of many, many years.
sentences.zh: 多年来我们一直目睹这一点。

sentences.en: So what he's asking of these people is no different than what he asked of them during the first impeachment or the second impeachment or when he was indicted.
sentences.zh: 所以他向这些人提出的要求，与他在第一次弹劾、第二次弹劾或他被起诉时提出的要求并无不同。

sentences.en: In this case, it is defend me, defend me, defend me.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，就是捍卫我，捍卫我，捍卫我。

sentences.en: And there is no exception made now that he has actually been convicted because Republicans don't believe this was a legitimate trial.
sentences.zh: 即便他现在真的被定罪了，也没有任何例外，因为共和党人并不认为这是一场合法的审判。

sentences.en: So this is not an intellectually hard leap for them to make.
sentences.zh: 所以这对他们来说在逻辑上并不难接受。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: He has, over the years, remade the Republican Party, this party of law and order, into the party of, when it comes to the law, whatever Donald Trump says.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他已经把共和党这个法律与秩序的政党，重塑成了在法律问题上唯唐纳德·特朗普马首是瞻的政党。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Instead of it once upon a time being the party of law and order where this kind of conduct would be shunned, where, say,
sentences.zh: 而不是像过去那样，作为一个崇尚法律和秩序的政党，这种行为本应受到唾弃，比如，

sentences.en: when Richard Nixon was in office and convinced to leave because of what he was facing in terms of possibly being ousted and not putting his party through that,
sentences.zh: 当理查德·尼克松在任时，因为面临被罢免的可能性，为了不让他的政党经历那种痛苦，他被劝说离职，

sentences.en: Donald Trump is going to put his party through that every single time.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普每次都要让他的政党经历那种痛苦。

sentences.en: And they will happily go through it with him at this point.
sentences.zh: 而此时此刻，他们会乐意陪他一起经历。

sentences.en: Well, to that point, there are, it would seem, two possibilities for how this all plays out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说到这一点，似乎有两种可能性来推演这一切的走向。

sentences.en: One is that Trump's conviction strategy, what we've been talking about here, it works because he hasn't just remade the Republican Party in his image.
sentences.zh: 一种是特朗普的定罪策略，也就是我们刚才讨论的，它奏效了，因为他不仅按照自己的形象重塑了共和党。

sentences.en: He's remade the entire country's expectations about what a president can or can't be.
sentences.zh: 他还重塑了整个国家对总统应有或不应有何种形象的预期。

sentences.en: The other possibility is that this approach is just wrong.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是这种方法完全错了。

sentences.en: And while Republicans are going to line up behind Trump because of it, average Americans, swing voters especially, won't.
sentences.zh: 虽然共和党人会因此站在特朗普身后，但普通美国人，尤其是摇摆选民，却不会。

sentences.en: And this will end up just recreating the Republican Party's problems from the last election, the 2022 midterms, when Trump's renegade outlaw approach,
sentences.zh: 这最终只会重演共和党在上一次选举，即2022年中期选举中的问题，当时特朗普那种叛逆的非法行径，

sentences.en: his insistence that the election was stolen, his defense of riots at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为选举被窃取，他为1月6日美国国会大厦的骚乱辩护，

sentences.en: Capitol on January 6th, ended up costing the Republican Party so many congressional elections.
sentences.zh: 最终导致共和党输掉了许多国会选举。

sentences.en: That could be happening because of Trump's message right now all over again in this presidential race.
sentences.zh: 在这次总统竞选中，由于特朗普现在的言论，这种情况可能再次发生。

sentences.en: That's exactly right, because, again, we just don't know which way this is going to play.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，因为同样地，我们不知道事态会如何发展。

sentences.en: So much of this is going to depend on how a narrow group of voters view this in a handful of states.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上取决于少数几个州的一小部分选民如何看待这件事。

sentences.en: And if there are enough people who can be persuaded by him that this really was an unfair thing that happened to him and evidence of a corrupted and corroded system,
sentences.zh: 如果能有足够多的人被他说服，认为发生在他身上的事确实不公平，是体制腐败和堕落的证据，

sentences.en: then maybe it will work.
sentences.zh: 那么这或许会奏效。

sentences.en: But if all Trump does is keep reminding people that he has engaged in conduct that other presidents have not, that could be a problem for him.
sentences.zh: 但如果特朗普只是不断提醒人们他参与了其他总统从未参与过的行为，那对他来说可能就是个问题。

sentences.en: Some of this depends, Michael, on what Democrats decide to do broadly, and we just don't know the answer to that yet.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这在一定程度上取决于民主党人决定采取什么广泛行动，而我们目前还不知道答案。

sentences.en: Democrats so far are very clearly conflicted about how to handle this.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，民主党人对于如何处理这件事显然存在分歧。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is not.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普则不然。

sentences.en: Not conflicted at all.
sentences.zh: 完全没有分歧。

sentences.en: Well, Maggie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，玛吉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague Reid Epstein takes us inside that Democratic conflict.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我的同事里德·爱泼斯坦将带我们深入了解民主党内部的这种分歧。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《联想》谜题，我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创作《拼字蜜蜂》和《字母盒》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Reid, you covered the Biden campaign for the Times.
sentences.zh: 里德，你曾为《时报》报道过拜登竞选团队。

sentences.en: We just talked to Maggie about how Donald Trump is trying to turn this negative, a conviction, into a positive by basically deciding to talk about it nonstop,
sentences.zh: 我们刚才和玛吉谈到了唐纳德·特朗普如何试图通过决定不停地谈论定罪这一负面事件，将其转化为正面事件，

sentences.en: which is a risky strategy.
sentences.zh: 这是一种冒险的策略。

sentences.en: In theory, Democrats have a simpler task here, which is to figure out what to do with a kind of political gift, their opponent leading in the polls,
sentences.zh: 理论上，民主党人在这里的任务更简单，那就是弄清楚如何处理这份“政治大礼”，他们的对手在民调中领先，

sentences.en: having been convicted of 34 crimes.
sentences.zh: 却被判犯有34项罪行。

sentences.en: But Maggie's final words to us were that Democrats were conflicted about how to handle this, suggesting that it is more complicated than it may seem.
sentences.zh: 但玛吉对我们说的最后的话是，民主党人对如何处理这件事感到矛盾，这表明它比看起来要复杂得多。

sentences.en: So my question to you is, is it and should it be complicated?
sentences.zh: 所以我问你，它复杂吗？它应该复杂吗？

sentences.en: Well, it usually is a good thing when your opponent is convicted of felonies during a campaign.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你的对手在竞选期间被判重罪时，这通常是一件好事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the campaign handbook, that is generally seen as a plus.
sentences.zh: 在竞选手册中，这通常被视为加分项。

sentences.en: However, we are living in the year 2024.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们生活在2024年。

sentences.en: President Biden is running for re-election, and he has a very complicated relationship with Donald Trump's legal probleMs.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统正在竞选连任，他与唐纳德·特朗普的法律问题有着非常复杂的关系。

sentences.en: He has, from the beginning, vowed to not discuss them.
sentences.zh: 他从一开始就发誓不讨论这些问题。

sentences.en: He has essentially ordered the White House and his campaign staff to stay away from any discussions of what the indictments would mean for his own political future and the presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 他基本上命令白宫和竞选团队远离任何关于起诉对他自己的政治前途和总统竞选意味着什么的讨论。

sentences.en: And why would that be?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样呢？

sentences.en: He does not want to be seen as pulling the strings for the man responsible for Trump being indicted when he ran for president in 2020.
sentences.zh: 他不希望被视为在操纵那些导致特朗普在2020年竞选总统时被起诉的人。

sentences.en: You may remember he ran on a return to normal, and one of the tenets of that was an independent Justice Department that would make decisions without influence from the White House.
sentences.zh: 你可能记得他竞选时主张回归常态，其中的原则之一就是独立的司法部，它在不受白宫影响的情况下做出决定。

sentences.en: But, Reid, importantly, this case that we're talking about and this conviction is not a federal case.
sentences.zh: 但是，里德，重要的是，我们谈论的这个案件和这次定罪并非联邦案件。

sentences.en: It is a local Manhattan criminal prosecution that has resulted in a conviction.
sentences.zh: 这是一起导致定罪的曼哈顿地方刑事诉讼。

sentences.en: So what has Biden's relationship been to that?
sentences.zh: 那么拜登与此案的关系如何？

sentences.en: Has that decree of don't talk about Trump's legal problems because I am president and I oversee the Department of Justice, has that applied to this case?
sentences.zh: 那个“不要谈论特朗普的法律问题，因为我是总统，我监管司法部”的法令，是否适用于此案？

sentences.en: It has, for the most part, held in this case.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，此案确实适用。

sentences.en: The Biden campaign has had a couple of sort of jokey asides referencing the Manhattan case.
sentences.zh: 拜登竞选团队曾有过几次类似开玩笑的侧面提及曼哈顿案件的情况。

sentences.en: If you remember when they made their offer to have a debate, Biden said that he would do it on Wednesdays because that was when Trump was free from the trial.
sentences.zh: 如果你记得他们提出辩论邀请时，拜登说他会在周三进行，因为那是特朗普没有审判的时间。

sentences.en: But for the most part, Biden has stayed pretty mute about the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，拜登对整件事保持了相当沉默。

sentences.en: And then on Thursday afternoon, when the verdict came in,
sentences.zh: 然后在周四下午，当判决结果出来时，

sentences.en: everyone in the universe that I report about was anxious and ready to see if it would change the Biden campaign's posture toward Donald Trump's legal issues.
sentences.zh: 我报道范围内的每个人都焦急地等待着，看这是否会改变拜登竞选团队对唐纳德·特朗普法律问题的立场。

sentences.en: And what we learned in the minutes after the verdict was delivered was that they were staying the course, essentially, that they issued a press release that said, essentially,
sentences.zh: 我们在判决宣布后的几分钟内了解到的是，他们基本上保持了既定方针，他们发布了一份新闻稿，大意是，

sentences.en: the only way to keep Donald Trump out of the White House is at the ballot box.
sentences.zh: 让唐纳德·特朗普远离白宫的唯一途径是在投票箱前。

sentences.en: And the next day, Biden himself gives a press conference at the White House.
sentences.zh: 第二天，拜登本人在白宫举行了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Before I begin my remarks, I just want to say a few words about what happened yesterday in New York City.
sentences.zh: 在开始我的讲话之前，我只想就昨天在纽约市发生的事情说几句话。

sentences.en: He spoke about Trump's verdict, the jury, the judicial process.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了特朗普的判决、陪审团和司法程序。

sentences.en: The jury heard five weeks of evidence, five weeks.
sentences.zh: 陪审团听取了五周的证据，整整五周。

sentences.en: And after careful deliberation, the jury reached a unanimous verdict.
sentences.zh: 经过仔细审议，陪审团达成了全体一致的判决。

sentences.en: They found Donald Trump guilty on all 34 felony counts.
sentences.zh: 他们裁定唐纳德·特朗普34项重罪指控全部成立。

sentences.en: And as far as Trump himself, Biden is pretty restrained.
sentences.zh: 至于特朗普本人，拜登表现得相当克制。

sentences.en: And it's reckless.
sentences.zh: 这是鲁莽的。

sentences.en: It's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这是危险的。

sentences.en: It's irresponsible for anyone to say this was rigged just because they don't like the verdict.
sentences.zh: 任何人仅仅因为不喜欢判决结果就说这是操纵的，是不负责任的。

sentences.en: He talks about how reckless it is for anybody to cast doubt upon the judicial system and the process through which Trump was convicted.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了任何人对司法系统以及特朗普被定罪的程序表示怀疑是多么鲁莽。

sentences.en: But he doesn't get into the specifics of Trump's case, nor does he dwell on Trump's new status as a convicted felon.
sentences.zh: 但他没有深入探讨特朗普案件的具体细节，也没有纠结于特朗普作为重罪犯的新身份。

sentences.en: The justice system should be respected.
sentences.zh: 司法系统应该受到尊重。

sentences.en: And we should never allow anyone to tear it down.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不应该允许任何人摧毁它。

sentences.en: And all told, he was done talking about Trump's case in a little less than two minutes.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，他谈论特朗普案件的时间不到两分钟。

sentences.en: This feels like a moment to pause on for just a moment because at the precise time that Trump becomes a convicted felon 34 times over,
sentences.zh: 这感觉是一个值得暂停片刻的时刻，因为就在特朗普成为34项重罪的重罪犯的同时，

sentences.en: and he is blasting out fundraising emails and saying, I'm a political prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他正在疯狂发送筹款邮件，声称自己是政治犯。

sentences.en: However, the Biden campaign, which is behind in the polls and is suddenly presented with, in theory, an opportunity to genuinely shake up this race,
sentences.zh: 然而，在民调中落后且突然获得了一个理论上可以真正撼动这场竞选的机会的拜登竞选团队，

sentences.en: those are rare opportunities in a campaign like this.
sentences.zh: 在这样的竞选中，这种机会是罕见的。

sentences.en: The Biden campaign barely touches it.
sentences.zh: 拜登竞选团队几乎没有触碰它。

sentences.en: They did not go in on it full bore the way that if the positions were reversed, you would expect Republicans to attack Biden on, right?
sentences.zh: 他们没有像如果立场互换，你预料共和党会攻击拜登那样全力以赴，对吧？

sentences.en: And we don't need to imagine what that would look like.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要想象那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: All you have to do is look at how they have responded and reacted to the president's son, Hunter Biden, being indicted on criminal charges himself.
sentences.zh: 你只需要看看他们是如何回应和反应总统的儿子亨特·拜登本人受到刑事指控的。

sentences.en: They have attacked Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 他们攻击了亨特·拜登。

sentences.en: They have suggested that his alleged crimes are the responsibility of his father.
sentences.zh: 他们暗示他所谓的罪行是他父亲的责任。

sentences.en: They have branded them both part of a Biden crime family.
sentences.zh: 他们给他们两人都贴上了“拜登犯罪家族”的标签。

sentences.en: And all this comes as Hunter Biden is scheduled to begin his own trial on Monday,
sentences.zh: 而这一切发生时，亨特·拜登定于周一开始他自己的审判，

sentences.en: making it all but certain that Republicans will continue to use that trial as fodder to attack President Biden and other Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这几乎可以肯定，共和党人将继续利用那场审判作为攻击拜登总统和其他民主党人的素材。

sentences.en: Pete, I wonder what the rest of the Democratic Party is thinking and saying about this very restrained Biden approach to Trump's conviction.
sentences.zh: 皮特，我想知道其他民主党人对于拜登这种对待特朗普定罪的克制态度是怎么想的，又在说什么。

sentences.en: Well, the minute the verdict came in, my colleague Nick Hamas and I began calling all manner of Democrats, senators, congressmen, state party chairs, strategists, on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，判决一出来，我的同事尼克·哈马斯和我就开始给各种民主党人打电话，参议员、国会议员、州党主席、战略家，等等等等。

sentences.en: And what we heard from in the end was a party that really was ready to go on the attack.
sentences.zh: 我们最终听到的是一个真正准备好发起攻击的政党。

sentences.en: We heard from Democrats like Senator Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts,
sentences.zh: 我们听到了像马萨诸塞州参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦这样的民主党人的声音，

sentences.en: who said the contrast in the campaign needs to be between a man of lies and chaos versus a guy who's trying to make the country work for everyone.
sentences.zh: 她说竞选中的对比应该是：一个谎言和混乱的制造者，与一个试图让国家为每个人服务的人之间的对比。

sentences.en: We heard from Beto O'Rourke, the Texas Democrat who ran for president.
sentences.zh: 我们听取了曾竞选总统的得克萨斯州民主党人贝托·奥罗克的意见。

sentences.en: Against Biden.
sentences.zh: 他曾与拜登竞争。

sentences.en: Against Biden, who said it's the obligation of every Democrat to remind every voter that Donald Trump is now a convicted felon and just how unprecedented this is.
sentences.zh: 他与拜登竞争，并表示每一位民主党人都有义务提醒每一位选民，唐纳德·特朗普现在是一名被定罪的重罪犯，而这种情况是前所未有的。

sentences.en: We heard from members of Congress.
sentences.zh: 我们听取了国会议员们的意见。

sentences.en: We heard from state legislators.
sentences.zh: 我们听取了州议员们的意见。

sentences.en: We heard from county and state party chairs.
sentences.zh: 我们听取了县和州党部主席们的意见。

sentences.en: And there is essentially no one who thinks that it shouldn't be part of the push that the party at large is making in terms of telling voters about Donald Trump that they want the words convicted felon to be included in every sentence that has the word Donald Trump in it.
sentences.zh: 基本上没有人认为，不应该把这一点作为整个民主党向选民宣传唐纳德·特朗普工作的一部分，他们希望在每一个提到唐纳德·特朗普名字的句子中，都包含“被定罪的重罪犯”这几个字。

sentences.en: This sounds like leading Democrats saying to Biden, do more, lean into this moment, play with this conviction.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是民主党高层在对拜登说：做得更多一点，抓住这个时机，利用好这次定罪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the reason they want that is that this conviction has the potential to reach the sort of voters who are not paying attention to the news.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以这样要求，是因为这次定罪有可能触及那些平时不关注新闻的选民。

sentences.en: We know that Joe Biden is weakest among people who don't read newspapers, who don't follow television news.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，乔·拜登在那些不读报纸、不看电视新闻的人群中支持率最弱。

sentences.en: And these are the sort of people who won't pay attention to some speech that Biden gives on a policy topic.
sentences.zh: 这些人通常不会去关注拜登在政策议题上发表的演讲。

sentences.en: But they're going to hear that Trump was convicted and Democrats think it's important to make sure that that gets baked in to how people feel about Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 但他们会听到特朗普被定罪的消息，民主党人认为，确保这一点深入人心，影响人们对唐纳德·特朗普的看法非常重要，

sentences.en: especially people who consume very little news.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对那些几乎不接触新闻的人来说。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, all of that seems to potentially point to the idea that President Biden in this moment, being as conflicted as he is about how to handle this conviction, and as a result,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有这些似乎都指向一个观点：拜登总统在这一刻，由于对如何处理这次定罪感到矛盾，结果导致，

sentences.en: being subtle and not figuring out how to really push on it, might be squandering his last real opportunity to fundamentally change a race that,
sentences.zh: 表现得过于谨慎，没能想出如何真正利用这一点，这可能会让他失去最后一次真正改变选情的机会，而根据几乎所有主要民调显示，他目前正处于落后状态。

sentences.en: according to almost all the major polls, he's behind in.
sentences.zh: 现在说他正在浪费这个机会可能还为时过早，因为特朗普是在周四被定罪的，他今天依然是被定罪的状态，下周也依然如此，

sentences.en: It may be too soon to say that he's squandering this because Trump was convicted on Thursday, he's still convicted today, he'll be convicted next week,
sentences.zh: 所以他们并没有排除利用这一点的可能性。

sentences.en: and so they have not foreclosed on the idea that they will not lean into this.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 他们只是现在还没这么做。

sentences.en: They just aren't doing it right now.
sentences.zh: 但他们每天都在失去时间，去弥补你所说的那些差距，对吧？

sentences.en: But they are running shorter on time every day to make up that ground that you talked about, right?
sentences.zh: 他在民调中落后。

sentences.en: He's trailing in the polls.
sentences.zh: 所以现在说他们正在浪费这个特定机会还为时过早，

sentences.en: And so it's too soon to say that they're squandering this particular opportunity,
sentences.zh: 但说他们花了很多时间却没能缩小与唐纳德·特朗普的差距，这并不为时过早。

sentences.en: but it's not too soon to say that they've spent a lot of time not making up ground against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 目前看来，在这场竞选中处于领先地位、且理论上因这次定罪损失最大的人，

sentences.en: And at the moment, it sure looks like the candidate in the lead in this race and with the most, in theory, to lose from this conviction,
sentences.zh: 反而拥有最稳健的计划来试图利用这一点。

sentences.en: has the most robust plan for trying to capitalize it.
sentences.zh: 那就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And that's Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而乔·拜登，本应从这次定罪中获益最多，却似乎非常倾向于淡化它，对此保持低调，不将其作为竞选的核心议题。

sentences.en: And Joe Biden, who would seem to have the most to gain from this conviction, seems very inclined to underplay it, be subtle about it, not make it a centerpiece of his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这对很多人来说确实会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And that's genuinely, I think, for a lot of people going to be surprising.
sentences.zh: 嗯，或许还有另一种看待这个问题的方式，那就是拜登竞选团队认为他们现在的做法恰到好处。

sentences.en: Well, there may be one other way to think about this, and that's that the Biden campaign thinks that they're playing this just the right way.
sentences.zh: 每一天，当唐纳德·特朗普谈论这次定罪有多么不公、审判有多么不公时，

sentences.en: Every day that Donald Trump talks about how unfair the conviction was and how unfair the trial was,
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登的竞选团队都认为这对他们有利，因为唐纳德·特朗普没有在谈论通货膨胀、边境问题，或者那些对乔·拜登来说处于国家政治讨论中心会非常不利的议题。

sentences.en: Joe Biden's campaign thinks that that's helpful for them because Donald Trump is not talking about inflation or the border or issues that are acutely bad for Joe Biden to have at the center of the nation's political discussion.
sentences.zh: 因此，乔·拜登和他的竞选团队很乐意看到特朗普召开30分钟的新闻发布会，对着法官、审判、规则、陪审团指示以及所有那些他们认为会让竞选焦点集中在特朗普本人身上，而不是让拜登团队去向那些不常关注新闻的选民传达信息的事情大发雷霆。

sentences.en: And so Joe Biden and his campaign are happy to have Trump do 30 minute press conferences where he rants and raves about the judge and the trial and the rules and the jury instruction and all those things that they think make this campaign about Trump himself and not about him saying things to some of these these infrequent and low information voters that the Biden campaign is doing.
sentences.zh: 如果那些人听到的是特朗普在谈论通货膨胀、边境问题，以及乔·拜登在这两个问题上表现不佳，

sentences.en: If those people were hearing Trump talk about inflation in the border and how Joe Biden has not performed well on those two issues,
sentences.zh: 我想拜登竞选团队会比现在特朗普谈论审判时感到更加担忧。

sentences.en: I think the Biden campaign would be sort of much more worried than if Trump is talking about the trial.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 你是说，在某种情况下，拜登竞选团队认为特朗普不停谈论此案的策略，不一定是在帮他自己，而是在帮他们。

sentences.en: You're saying there's a world where the Biden campaign sees Trump's strategy of talking about this case nonstop as helping not necessarily him, but them.
sentences.zh: 但如果特朗普被定罪后说“那件事结束了，我要谈谈边境和经济”，我想拜登团队会担心得多。

sentences.en: But then if Trump was convicted and said that's over, I'm going to talk about the border and the economy, I think the Biden people would be a lot more worried.
sentences.zh: 好的，里德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Well, Reid, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 在周五的一次详细演讲中，拜登总统支持了一项旨在结束加沙战争的计划，该计划将促成永久停火。

sentences.en: In a detailed speech on Friday, President Biden endorsed a plan to end the war in Gaza that would lead to a permanent ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 分阶段释放哈马斯扣押的所有以色列人质，并从加沙撤出所有以色列军队。

sentences.en: The phased release of all Israeli hostages held by Hamas and the withdrawal of all Israeli troops from Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这次演讲是拜登试图向以色列领导人本雅明·内塔尼亚胡施压，促使其接受该提议。

sentences.en: The speech was an attempt by Biden to pressure Israel's leader, Benjamin Netanyahu, into accepting the proposal.
sentences.zh: 但内塔尼亚胡极右翼联盟中的两名成员立即拒绝了该计划，并威胁称如果他接受，他们将退出政府。

sentences.en: But two members of Netanyahu's far-right coalition immediately rejected the plan, threatening to quit his government if he accepts it.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡本人也表达了保留意见，称以色列尚未完成摧毁哈马斯的任务。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu himself expressed reservations, saying that Israel had not yet completed the job of destroying Hamas.
sentences.zh: 非洲人国民大会（非国大），这个将南非从种族隔离中解放出来并自1994年以来一直执政的政党，已经失去了在该国的政治垄断地位。

sentences.en: And the African National Congress, the party that freed South Africa from apartheid and has held power there since 1994, has lost its political monopoly over the country.
sentences.zh: 在最近的选举中，该党仅获得了40%的选票，远低于上次选举的得票率。

sentences.en: In the latest election, the party received only 40% of the vote, far less than it got in the last election.
sentences.zh: 分析人士表示，高失业率、电力短缺和猖獗的犯罪行为导致非国大失去了曾经坚不可摧的支持。

sentences.en: Analysts said that high unemployment, shortages of electricity, and rampant crime cost the ANC its once unbreakable support.
sentences.zh: 为了维持执政，该党现在必须与竞争对手拼凑出一个联合政府。

sentences.en: To stay in power, the party must now cobble together a coalition government with its rivals.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由雷切尔·奎斯特、阿斯塔·查图尔维迪、穆吉·扎迪和戴安娜·阮制作。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rachel Quester, Astha Chaturvedi, Mooj Zadhi, and Diana Nguyen.
sentences.zh: 由德文·泰勒剪辑，包含马里昂·洛萨诺、帕特·麦卡斯克和艾丽西亚·拜图布的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: It was edited by Devin Taylor, contains original music by Marion Lozano, Pat McCusker, and Alicia Baitoub, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福克创作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansfork of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我是莎拉·凯尼格，本期将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
